Insight icons — the FUNCTIONS lens:
  • function — a module-level def.
  • method — a def bound to a class.
  • endpoint handler — a route decorator serves it.
  • base — calls no other documented function; a foundation others build on.
  • N god-function flag — length ≥ 50 lines; makes it a split candidate below.
  • fn N% closest structural twin — body-identifier overlap (Jaccard); a ≥85% pair becomes a merge candidate below.
  • orphan — served by no endpoint, referenced by no mapped code; becomes a deprecation candidate below.
  • Usage bars: teal = api (endpoints served + api-layer files referencing) · violet = internal (mapped files referencing — same-file calls outside the def count: a helper used within its module is used).
